source.subject: feat: route whole-chunk FP8 Prefill projections

frozen_baseline_binary.role: C512 scheduler with the promoted bulk causal GQA and whole-chunk NVFP4 Down routes, before the FP8 whole-chunk production route
frozen_baseline_binary.source_scope_note: The binary, rather than an inferred source-tree identity, is the frozen comparator. Test-only FP8 QKV/Z and GDN probes present while it was built did not change the production runner route.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin, one pinned checkpoint, batch one, output one, and direct native-runner timing

production_route.selected_kernel: one fixed N-major whole-chunk grid, 256 threads, M64-by-N128 logical CTA arithmetic
production_route.replaced_c512_route: sixteen ordered C32 projection kernels per layer and selected shape

p513_theoretical_projection_nodes.note: The 2,560-node value follows the exact previous C32 launch contract. The 160-node candidate count is confirmed by the production Nsight profile.

production_route.eligibility: exact C256/C512, selected SM87 backend, exact QKV/Z/O shape, 16-byte weight alignment, 8-byte input alignment, 2-byte output alignment, and a complete valid Fp8LinearWeight payload
production_route.payload_contract: Both device companion-scale pointers remain mandatory and are validated even though the whole-chunk kernel consumes the validated host weight scale directly.
production_route.fallback: Structural and production-alignment near misses return cudaErrorNotSupported before enqueue and retain the established ordered C32 route. Malformed scalar, pointer, byte-range, or alias contracts return cudaErrorInvalidValue without fallback or enqueue.
production_route.other_routes: C64 FP8 attention output, smaller projection tiles, full-attention Q/K/V, BF16 and NVFP4 projections, and every other shape retain their prior routes.

prerequisite_screens.interpretation: These test-only screens admitted the arithmetic kernel. The formal whole-model result below is the production-dispatch promotion gate.

formal_protocol.prompt_construction: P(N) uses N-12 space-separated copies of ASCII hello and the pinned non-thinking single-user chat template.
formal_protocol.comparison: arithmetic mean of mirrored process medians: B=(B1+B2)/2 and C=(C1+C2)/2
formal_protocol.prefix_definition: all prompt tokens except the final prompt token and LM head

streaming_canonical_extraction.method: For each B1/C1/C2/B2 log, stream lines matching ^(projection\.backend|prefill\.(requested|effective)_chunk_size|benchmark\.(prompt_count|max_new_tokens|stop_token_id)|prompt\.[01]\.(prompt_ids|generated_ids|generated_text|stop_reason|step_count|steps))= through SHA-256.

correctness.full_reference_oracle: pass: 19 prompt IDs, 26 generated IDs, exact text, im_end, and 44 steps on the SM87 backend
correctness.dispatch_contract: pass: exact QKV/Z/O C256/C512 each capture as one direct-function-identical N-major kernel; one-node real-storage replay writes both output edges; near misses return NotSupported with zero nodes; malformed full-span payloads and aliases return Invalid with zero nodes; a C256 shape near miss retains 32 ordered fallback nodes
correctness.host_selector_contract: pass: selects exact aligned QKV/Z/O C256/C512, rejects backend/token/shape/type/alignment near misses, and leaves malformed companion pointers to runtime validation

memory.assessment: The route changes launch topology only. It does not add a sidecar, request workspace, persistent allocation, or buffering tier.

nsight_p513_c512.protocol: candidate production binary, tokenizer-pinned P513, output one, C512, SM87 backend, NVTX phase ranges enabled, no benchmark warmup; diagnostic topology and attribution rather than the formal latency distribution
nsight_p513_c512.interpretation: The three exact kernel rows and launch counts prove that every eligible pinned-model layer uses one whole-chunk grid. The profile does not claim all saved wall time equals removed launch overhead; the kernels also reuse decoded weights across M64 panels.

external_reference.accounting: P divided by scheduled-to-first-token for stock vLLM and P divided by native TTFT for this candidate
external_reference.stock_vllm_backend: FlashInfer for 16 full-attention layers, Triton/FLA GDN Prefill for 48 linear-attention layers, and Marlin FP8/NVFP4 projections
external_reference.interpretation: This is a matched batch-one/output-one directional reference, not a same-binary benchmark. The promoted native route remains about 2.78x-2.98x behind the measured stock vLLM reference and is not claimed to approach the user's separately tuned 2k-8k token/s vLLM result.

decision.result: promote exact aligned C256/C512 FP8 QKV, Z, and attention-output whole-chunk routes
decision.why: All runtime/dispatch/model/memory gates pass. The isolated QKV/Z and attention-output screens had already selected the arithmetic kernel; the production-only delta now improves mirrored Prefix by 1.09841x at P257 and 1.09954x at P513, improves complete-prompt TTFT by 1.09276x and 1.09664x, and Nsight confirms all 160 eligible layer projections use one whole-chunk grid.
decision.retained_boundaries: The generic projection limit remains C64; unsupported cases preserve C32 fallback; Decode, default C1, persistent memory, MTP policy, and Prefill/Decode execution ownership are unchanged.
decision.next_priority: Use the fresh production profile to screen whole-chunk full-attention Q plus K/V projection routes, then pursue a materially different GDN or NVFP4 Gate/Up mechanism. Gate/Up whole-chunk is not enabled from an earlier binary's synthetic result alone.

limitations: The formal result is batch one, max1, one checkpoint, one Orin, fixed clocks, and mirrored process medians; it is not concurrent serving throughput, a latency-tail, power, or energy result.

Native Prefix excludes the final prompt token and LM head. The complete-prompt P/TTFT values are the proper directional cross-framework accounting, but native and vLLM clocks are still independent runtime measurements rather than a same-binary trial.

The native candidate reaches 134.351126 and 137.928939 complete-prompt token/s at P257/P513. It remains 2.780617x and 2.982587x behind the measured stock vLLM reference and is not claimed to be near the user's separately tuned 2k-8k token/s vLLM result.
FlashInfer, MTP, continuous batching, double/triple buffering, Prefill/Decode overlap, and an OpenAI-compatible server are not used or introduced.
The Nsight report is one no-warmup diagnostic process. Its route topology is authoritative for that trace; the formal B1-C1-C2-B2 logs remain authoritative for latency.
